'''Anya Foravis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bakuran]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Foravis served in the [[Bakuran military police]] and later joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. She was assigned to serve aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was one of a group of ''Executor'' crewmen who were assigned to investigate the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]].
